component.name: Meridian
component.summary: Plan astrophotography sessions and inspect FITS file metadata

description.p: A desktop application for astrophotographers that combines session planning with FITS file management. Plan your imaging nights with the built-in sky planner, then scan and review your sessions after the fact.

ul.li: Observation planner with NGC/IC/Messier catalog (Seestar-optimised filters)
Altitude and visibility calculations for your location and chosen night
Recursive directory scanning for .fit and .fits files
FITS header metadata extraction — no Python required
Target grouping with total integration time aggregation
Calibration frame summaries grouped by type and settings
Imaging calendar with moon phase and historical weather data
Catalog breakdown by Messier, NGC, IC, Sharpless, and more
Image viewer with live stretch controls and rejection workflow
File organiser tools for Siril preparation and cleanup

description.p: Interactive 360° Sky Arc Detailed planetarium view with a live star field, Observed Sky Paths chart, month/7-day/3-day Imaging Calendar views, resilient scanning, and a location-correct planner timeframe. Version bump to 1.0.3a.
Viewable-area compass filter, UTC/AM-PM clock toggle, and sky arc improvements in Observation Planner. Version bump to 1.0.2a.
KIO worker bundled for native file dialog support in AppImage. Version bump to 1.0.1a.
